# GitHub repository About

These are the suggested values for the repository's **About** panel. GitHub does not apply this file automatically when it is pushed.

**Description**

Turn lectures into structured notes, concept maps and recall cards in your browser. Choose your own AI providers, keep a local library, and resume interrupted work.

**Website**

https://mauryapranav.github.io/Delectured/

To apply them, open [the repository](https://github.com/mauryapranav/Delectured) while signed in as an owner, select the settings icon beside **About**, paste the description and website, and save.
